_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd night_of_the_dead/egg-pterodactyl-night-of-the-dead.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence) at 8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8. Octail fixes the config edits ({{server.environment.X}} instead of {{env.X}}) and writes them to both ServerSettings.ini files the server may read (the shipped one in the server folder and LF/Saved/Config/), adds max players, makes the admin password optional, refuses quotes and backslashes in the name, downloads the ServerSettings.ini template from the pinned commit (upstream: main) only when the game ships none and fails the install when that fails, installs the Steam client libraries (app 1007) next to the executable and refreshes them after updates, quotes ?listen (a shell pattern), drops the free-form extra arguments, adds the night-of-the-dead tag, the no_console_input flag, the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, install sandbox defaults and resource hints, port readiness (x_octail.features.ready) besides the session lines, stops with Ctrl+C handed to the server by a trap (the wine image runs the line in bash as PID 1, which ignores it otherwise; upstream's tail ended the container before the server) and waits for it, and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".
name: Night of the Dead
author: marshals@gmail.com
description: Build defenses against nightly waves of zombies, survive and escape the island. The Windows dedicated server, run under Wine.

startup_commands.Default: export SteamAppId=1377380; for dll in steamclient64.dll tier0_s64.dll vstdlib_s64.dll; do [ -f "${dll}" ] && cp -u "${dll}" LF/Binaries/Win64/; done; wine ./LF/Binaries/Win64/LFServer-Win64-Shipping.exe '?listen' -Port={{SERVER_PORT}} -QueryPort={{QUERY_PORT}} -log & NOTD_PID=$!; trap "kill -INT ${NOTD_PID} 2>/dev/null; wait ${NOTD_PID}" INT TERM; tail -c0 -F /home/container/LF/Saved/Logs/LF.log --pid=${NOTD_PID} 2>/dev/null & wait ${NOTD_PID}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
## Octail curated install: SteamCMD downloads the Windows build of the server (it runs under Wine).
## Server Files: /mnt/server

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fsSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "Downloading SteamCMD failed."; exit 1; }
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: the Steam client libraries (app 1007) next to the server's executable, as the game needs them
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +app_update 1007 +quit || echo "Downloading the Steam client libraries failed; the server may not be listed."

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/LF/Binaries/Win64/LFServer-Win64-Shipping.exe" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Night of the Dead dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

cd /mnt/server
for dll in steamclient64.dll tier0_s64.dll vstdlib_s64.dll; do
    [[ -f "$dll" ]] && cp -fv "$dll" LF/Binaries/Win64/
done

## Octail: ServerSettings.ini is read from the server folder (the shipped one) and LF/Saved/Config/; both get the
## Startup tab's values before every start. The template from the pinned commit when the game ships none; an
## existing one is kept.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/LF/Saved/SaveGames /mnt/server/LF/Saved/Config
if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/ServerSettings.ini ]]; then
    curl -fsSL -o /mnt/server/ServerSettings.ini https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd/8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8/night_of_the_dead/ServerSettings.ini || { echo "Downloading ServerSettings.ini failed."; exit 1; }
fi
if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/LF/Saved/Config/ServerSettings.ini ]]; then
    cp /mnt/server/ServerSettings.ini /mnt/server/LF/Saved/Config/ServerSettings.ini
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server list (no double quotes or backslashes). Written to ServerSettings.ini.
variables.default_value: Octail Night of the Dead Server

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join. Empty = no password.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: How many players may join at once.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: The password for in-game admin commands. Set one: with none, nobody can log in as admin.

variables.name: Message of the Day
variables.description: Shown to players when they join.

variables.name: Save Name
variables.description: The world (LF/Saved/SaveGames/<name>). A new name starts a new world; the old one stays.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: Custom uses the values under [GameSettings/Basic] and [GameSettings/Advanced] in ServerSettings.ini.

variables.name: PvE
variables.description: 1 = PvE (players can't hurt each other), 0 = PvP.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port (UDP), for the server list. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start (1 = on, 0 = off).

variables.name: Windows Install
variables.description: Downloads the Windows build (the server runs under Wine).
